messages:
jorge: Postmortem follow-up: canary failed to auto-rollback on a 10% error spike. Creating a single thread to capture owners, timelines, and recurring-pattern checks.

mira: Thanks. Quick notes from the postmortem: feature-flag timeouts + retry storms caused inconsistent decisioning. Also saw delayed metric emission which hid the spike until it was too late.

eli: Re: delayed metrics 10% error spike was visible in raw request logs at t+30s but our canary health metric pipeline batches every 60s. I propose adding a fast-path short-window metric for canaries (10s window) that bypasses aggregation.

samira: I'll own the fast-path metric. Plan: instrument a canary_health_fast counter and add a short-window alert rule. Dry-run in staging within 48h.

lina: For the feature-flag dependency, suggest controller-level fallback: if flag lookup returns 5xx or times out >1s for 5% of requests over 1m, treat flags as OFF for the canary and roll back. I can spec the config.

eli: I'll update the controller to support a fallback policy and expose "flag_health" metric. PR goal: 2 business days.

samira: Alert logic draft: alert if canary_health_fast error_rate > 7% for 3 buckets of 10s OR if flag_health < 95% for 1m. Trigger: automated rollback + page oncall.

ops_bot: scheduled maintenance window: run staging dry-run Monday 02:00 UTC

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-controller v0.9.2 -> staging

mira: Blast-radius controls: add rollout fields max_percentage, max_customers, and a per-customer "slo_pin" label that prevents rollout for pinned customers. Lina, can you include schema changes and migration notes?

lina: Yes. Will add schema + validation. Migration plan: default values preserve current behavior. ETA: 10 days for rollout with migration scripts.

product-lead: Product asks for a simple UI toggle to mark a customer as "slo_pin". We can add later but want API first.

samira: Also recommend a post-incident checklist item: run a "canary blast radius audit" monthly to detect configs that allow wide exposure. I'll add a recurring ticket.

jorge: Action list to track in one ticket (I'll create):
- samira: canary_health_fast metric + alert + staging dry-run (48h)
- eli: controller fallback + flag_health metric PR (2d)
- lina: rollout schema + max_* args + migration (10d)
- ops: run staging dry-run during maintenance window and validate rollback execution (Mon)
- product-lead: UI toggle backlog item (next sprint)
- devops: add dashboard tile for canary health and last-rollback status (sprint-1)

mira: Please add assignees and due dates in the ticket. We'll do a 48h progress check-in.

eli: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/canary-controller/pull/1302 (wip)

samira: Created tracking ticket: RI-4523 (link: https://tickets.redwood/RI-4523) with owners and deadlines.

jorge: Great. I'll close the loop after the first dry-run and update the postmortem with the remediation timeline and recurring-audit cadence. Thanks everyone.
